text:
Anna (Design): Dropping a fresh iteration of the latency & throughput observability panels. Primary goals: highlight p95, offer p99 as secondary, heatmap density controls, a clearer time-range picker, and user-adjustable sampling (fidelity). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXXX/observability-latency

Miguel (Product): Looks good. Make p95 the default view but make p99 one click away. Customers ask for both often.

Sofia (Eng-Platform): Fine with p95 default. Note: exact p99 across many routes and long time windows is expensive to compute.

Mark (Eng-ML): We should provide an approximate p99 for wide ranges (reservoir sampling or t-digest) and only do exact p99 for selected routes or explicit user requests.

Anna (Design): UX idea: solid p95 line, optional dotted p99 line. Show a small helper: "p99 may be approximate for ranges >24h" and an "approx" badge when approximation applies.

Miguel (Product): Add the "approx" badge. Also make the metric toggle discoverable on mobile.

Jules (Accessibility): Colour/contrast: the dotted p99 is currently too faint. Ensure contrast >=4.5:1. Also keyboard focus states for the metric toggle and legend items.

Anna (Design): Will increase contrast and add visible focus rings.

Sofia (Eng-Platform): Heatmap backend question: do we render from sampled events or from aggregated counters per bucket/min? Sampling yields lower cost but can smooth spikes.

Mark (Eng-ML): Use aggregated counters per bucket/min for the default heatmap. Expose sampling controls so customers can increase fidelity when investigating tails.

Anna (Design): Draft control: "Data fidelity: Auto / Low / Medium / High" with tooltip "Lower fidelity reduces query cost; higher fidelity improves tail accuracy." Any wording suggestions?

Miguel (Product): For compact views, label it "Fidelity" and keep the tooltip saying "Sampling level". Less technical for product users.

Jules (Accessibility): Add aria-describedby linking the control to the tooltip content. Avoid color-only states; include icons or text.

Anna (Design): Adding icons + text and ARIA hooks.

Sofia (Eng-Platform): Time ranges: presets Last 15m, 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d, Custom. Show inline hint: "Data older than 24h may be downsampled." Clamp max selectable to 90d and require confirmation beyond that.

Anna (Design): I'll add the hint and a confirmation modal for >90d.

Mark (Eng-ML): Auto-aggregation: when long ranges are selected, coarsen heatmap buckets automatically and expose an "Auto-aggregate for long ranges" toggle (on by default).

Miguel (Product): Add mini-sparklines in the routes list showing p95 trend for quick scan. Click opens full route detail.

Sofia (Eng-Platform): Sparklines can be produced from precomputed aggregates; we'll need to rate-limit the number of routes requested per load.

Anna (Design): Legend behavior: selected series first, then others. Add drag handles for power users to reorder; include keyboard move up/move down alternatives.

Jules (Accessibility): Provide keyboard menu actions for reordering; drag is not sufficient for accessibility.

design-bot: Figma v4 uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXXX/observability-latency (comments enabled).

Miguel (Product): Copy tweak: use "Data fidelity" in full view and "Fidelity" in compact; A/B test both.

Anna (Design): Will add both variants into the comps and note in comments.

Sofia (Eng-Platform): Implementation note: support query param sampling_level and header X-Exact-Tail to request exact tail calculations (Dedicated customers can opt-in).

Mark (Eng-ML): Add server-side feature flag for exact tail queries on enterprise plans.

Anna (Design): I'll update the mock to reflect colour/focus changes, legend reorder with keyboard actions, time-range wording, the approximation helper, and sampling label variants. Ping when v4.1 is ready.

Miguel (Product): Please add a concise changelog in Figma comments listing behavioural changes (auto-aggregate, approximate p99 rules, sampling semantics).

Jules (Accessibility): I'll run an a11y pass after the next upload.

Sofia (Eng-Platform): I'll prototype sampling query param and reservoir approximate p99. Target: PR next week.

Anna (Design): If no objections, I'll queue these for the Console sprint. :thumbsup:

Miguel (Product): :thumbsup:

Mark (Eng-ML): :thumbsup:
